query: SELECT created_at_ms as "created_at_ms!",wakeup_id as "wakeup_id!",remote as "remote!" FROM (SELECT created_at_ms,wakeup_id,0 AS remote FROM wakeup_definitions UNION ALL SELECT created_at_ms,wakeup_id,1 AS remote FROM remote_wake_requests WHERE wakeup_id IS NOT NULL) WHERE (created_at_ms,wakeup_id)<=(?,?) AND (? IS NULL OR (created_at_ms,wakeup_id)>(?,?)) ORDER BY created_at_ms,wakeup_id LIMIT ?
